summary: Iteration 23 - Energy Monitoring GPS/Map, Ingest API, and Account-level Time Access testing completed. All 16 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified working including OpenStreetMap integration, fuchsia color scheme, and admin permissions UI.

gps_location_api_all_devices.result: Returns GPS coordinates (50.43 N, 7.42 E near Neuwied) for all devices with P_sum_kW for map popups

gps_location_api_single_device.result: Returns latest GPS data including gps_lat, gps_lon, gps_alt_m, gps_speed_mps, gps_mode

ingest_api_sync_state.result: Returns last_sync_id for device/meter pair. Requires API key auth.

ingest_api_batch_data.result: Accepts batch EMU data records with API key auth. Returns inserted count.

ingest_api_generate_key.result: Admin-only endpoint generates 32-char API key for Pi sync

pi_sync_script_download.result: Returns emu_sync.py Python script with EMU Pi Sync documentation

account_level_time_access.result: Updates access_type (permanent/temporary), access_start, access_end at account level

hub_page_fuchsia_color.test: Energy Monitoring button uses fuchsia color
hub_page_fuchsia_color.result: Button icon container has class bg-fuchsia-100, hover:bg-fuchsia-600

openstreetmap_dashboard_map.test: Dashboard shows OpenStreetMap with device markers
openstreetmap_dashboard_map.result: Leaflet map container with markers at correct GPS coordinates

openstreetmap_detail_map.test: Detail page shows GPS map with device location

time_range_selector.test: Time range selector with 'Alle Daten' option
time_range_selector.result: 'Alle Daten' shows 2000 data points from historical EMU data

admin_modal_energy_settings.test: Admin user modal shows Energy Monitoring permissions
admin_modal_energy_settings.result: Toggle for enabled, access_all, individual Messkoffer selection, and account-level time access with date pickers

seed_data_creation: Real EMU data from emu.db already imported (34,277 records from Feb 18-19 2026)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 23 complete. New features tested: GPS/Location endpoints (GET /api/energy-monitoring/locations and /devices/:id/location), Ingest API for Pi sync (POST /api/energy-monitoring/ingest, GET /api/energy-monitoring/ingest/sync-state, POST /api/energy-monitoring/ingest/generate-key), Pi sync script download (GET /api/download-sync-script), Account-level time access (access_type, access_start, access_end on User model). All features working. OpenStreetMap integration showing device at 50.43 N, 7.42 E near Neuwied. Hub page Energy Monitoring button uses fuchsia color. Real EMU data contains 34,277 telemetry records with GPS coordinates.
